notes:
Every person gets one private drive, and the home gets one shared Drive.

- My Drive is private to its owner; share files and folders with chosen people.
- The Shared Drive is open to the whole home; stars are kept per person.
- Folders you pick on a computer sync like Syncthing; linked folders and volumes are gone.
- Photos now read the same access rule; Memories are removed from the Hub.
- Update the app and Desktop together with this release.
